title: Demo Specification
description: Structured input that a non-engineer (or AI on their behalf) provides to spawn or configure a demo. Captures intent so the AI never has to guess theming, custody, corridor, or other implicit context.

id.description: URL-safe identifier. Generated by the dashboard, not user-supplied.

demoType.description: Which canonical demo template this instance is built from. Determines which apps/<demoType>/ scaffold and dashboard section are used.

description.description: Optional short blurb shown in dashboard listing.

brandRef.description: ID of a brand record under apps/dashboard/.../brands/. The single source of truth for theming. Demos do not embed colors/logos — they reference a brand.

flow.description: Optional per-segment partner choices. Omit fields to accept the demo type's defaults.

onramp.description: Partner ID for fiat→stablecoin (e.g. 'coinbase', 'iron', 'mtlco'). Must be registered in demo-registry.md.

bridge.description: Cross-chain bridge/swap (e.g. 'lifi', 'fireblocks-orders'). May be 'none' for same-chain flows.

corridor.description: Optional currency/region pair. Required for sandwich-type demos; ignored otherwise.

ownerId.description: User ID who created this spec. Set server-side from session, not by the AI.
